description:
Some people say, “the government created the Bible to control you.”
But that claim completely falls apart under even basic scrutiny.

If the Bible were a tool of kings and politicians, they’re doing a terrible job promoting their own propaganda. Mainstream media relentlessly mocks Christianity, while nearly every other religion is treated as untouchable. Satanism is openly celebrated in music videos and concerts, yet the Bible is banned, censored, or removed from public life.

In fact, Scripture is illegal or restricted in over 50 countries, and countless believers have been imprisoned or killed for refusing to deny it. In the U.S., Bible reading was removed from schools in 1963. Bible verses are prohibited in many military contexts. Even public spaces and sporting events forbid Scripture displays. That doesn’t look like promotion — it looks like suppression.

And here’s the irony: the same governments accused of “creating the Bible” proudly print “In God We Trust” on their currency — right next to an Egyptian all-seeing Eye of Horus, a pagan symbol. If they truly wanted people obeying the Bible, why embed occult imagery while systematically pushing Scripture out of society?

The Bible isn’t a single book written by elites. It’s 66 books, over 40 authors, written across 1,500 years, from fishermen to kings — many of whom were persecuted or executed for what they wrote. Yet its message is unified, prophetic, and directly challenges corrupt power structures.

From Moses confronting Pharaoh, to Rome executing Christ, to Scripture warning that Satan is the god of this world and that we wrestle against principalities and rulers of darkness, the Bible doesn’t teach submission to corrupt governments — it teaches obedience to God over man.

So the next time someone claims the Bible was created to control you...Ask them why the world works so hard to silence it.
👉 If you’ve heard that claim before, share this.

- Candid Truth
